newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway's Brundtland says no change in policies.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Brundtland says no change in policies.

text.p: Norwegian Prime Minister Gro Harlem Brundtland, who said on Wednesday she will hand over power to Labour Party leader Thorbjoern Jagland on Friday, said there would be no change in economic or other policies as a result of the change.
"The same political direction will stay in place. It is not to be expected neither nationally nor internationally that there will be a shift in policy.
"The Labour Party's principal targets will remain employment, welfare and concern for future generations," she said.
